content:
Never finalize a sheep ID below medium confidence without owner confirmation. Owner testimony overrides DB text AND overrides pedigree-based inferences.

Complements prior memory 52883364 (workflow doc); this is the specific don't-guess rule.

Cautionary examples from 2026-04-26 Pen 3 session:
- Misread Charlie at hay cage as Nori (both dark-faced at distance)
- Placed charlies-farm-ewe-baby-p3 (MC-2602) near her dam on the right; she was actually on the LEFT of hay cage
- Assumed lamb proximity-to-dam was reliable — not always; lambs cluster with other lambs
- All resolved through 4 rounds of operator clarification

RULE: list IDs with confidence levels, name confusion pairs explicitly, ask operator about anything below medium. Pedigree-based face-color assumptions unreliable (Hampshire sire ≠ black-faced offspring if dam pigment dominates).

See docs/sheep_visual_id_process.md for full workflow.
